project_info.theme: Ayam Taliwang from Lombok ingredient showcase
project_info.color_palette: Charcoal black, ember orange, chili red, grilled brown, white labels

main_subject.detail: A whole flattened char-grilled Ayam Taliwang rests on a worn wooden board above glowing coals, with glossy red chili glaze and smoke.
main_subject.style: Dramatic fire-lit food magazine photography with floating annotated ingredients

composition_elements.text: AYAM TALIWANG; ASAL: LOMBOK, NTB; CABE KERING; CABE RAWIT; TERASI BAKAR; BAWANG PUTIH; TOMATO; PLECING KANGKUNG
items: Top: fiery orange-gold AYAM TALIWANG title and origin line.
Middle: dried chilies, bird's-eye chilies, grilled shrimp paste, garlic, tomato, and water spinach float in a vertical cascade.
Sides: thin white pointer lines and bold Indonesian ingredient labels.
Bottom: lacquered grilled chicken on rustic board above coals, embers, smoke, and strong warm backlight.
Background: deep red-black smoky field with flying sparks.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: High contrast, ember particles, smoke plumes, glossy glaze highlights, frozen food motion

assets.name: Ayam Taliwang plated food reference
assets.usage: Preserve the grilled flattened chicken form, chili glaze, and regional serving cues.

assets.name: ingredient label layout
assets.usage: Keep the separated levitating ingredients, white callout lines, and Indonesian labels.

assets.name: ember and charcoal set
assets.usage: Maintain a controlled fiery atmosphere without obscuring food.

prompt_instructions: Attach recipe-accurate food imagery for fidelity.
Confirm dish origin and Indonesian ingredient spelling before publishing.
Set headline and small labels in post-production for exact legibility.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: A hyper-realistic Indonesian food infographic poster with dramatic floating ingredients. Vertical composition, bold title text at the top showing the dish name and origin (ASAL). Ingredients levitating in mid-air with clean white label lines and Indonesian text. Cinematic food photography style, ultra-detailed textures, glossy sauces, charred meat, fresh vegetables, steam and smoke effects. Strong contrast lighting, editorial layout, modern typography, professional food magazine look, motion-frozen splashes, realistic shadows, studio lighting, shallow depth of field, 8K ultra-realistic, DSLR quality.
prompt.negative_prompt: undercooked chicken, inaccurate dish styling, weak firelight, cluttered labels, illegible Indonesian text, flat texture, low resolution, watermark, signature
